* '''Playtest''' ([[A New Hope (Virtual Set 27) (Playtest)]]): Playtest image: PC card image of 19 August 2026<ref name="ht-nh-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/9aaa4af0babb58c41dad0a6767d432b3a51e1f4c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/anewhope.gif anewhope.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/9aaa4af0babb58c41dad0a6767d432b3a51e1f4c 9aaa4af] (19 August 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. Destiny printed “4” (Virtual Set 27 preview). Text: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, ▲ Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy < 4.”
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 1 September 2026<ref name="ht-nh-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/b4f45e2e08125618fe25af7b02e71fa092ea379c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/anewhope.gif anewhope.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/b4f45e2e08125618fe25af7b02e71fa092ea379c b4f45e2] (1 September 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: the destiny number “4” becomes the Roman numeral “IV”. Game text unchanged. Text: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, ▲ Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy < 4.”
